observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR lens with front glass visible; lens barrel has ribbed focus/zoom area and a printed label on the side.
Photo 1 shows the side label area more clearly; it reads “Nikon” and “AF-S NIKKOR”, but the key model text is partially obscured by a black/blur block.
Photo 2 shows the front element and the lens mount area; the front ring text is visible but the exact focal length/aperture model line is not fully readable due to blur/angle.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of country of origin; only the lens brand/type is visible.
Photos show the lens, but do not confirm internal haze/fungus/scratches or optical performance; front glass appears reflective but condition is not provable from these angles.

risks.risk: Exact lens model (focal length + maximum aperture) is not readable because the model text is obscured/blurred; price depends heavily on the exact model.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the side label showing the full model line (e.g., the part that includes focal length and aperture) with no blur/black block.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a worst-case generic Nikon AF-S kit/standard zoom used-lens level (not the specific higher-value model).

risks.risk: Optical defects (fungus, haze, scratches, separation) not reliably detectable from these photos.
risks.proof: Video/clip through the lens at an angle with bright light (flashlight) showing the front and rear elements, plus a photo of both elements straight-on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed optically perfect (assume possible minor issues).

risks.risk: Autofocus/AF motor may be weak or faulty; photos cannot confirm functionality.
risks.proof: Short test clip: mount on a Nikon camera, focus on a near object then far object; show focus confirmation/beep and sharpness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: AF not reliable (manual focus only).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or wrong mount compatibility (e.g., Nikon F-mount vs other); photos don’t show full compatibility details.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear mount (contacts) and a shot showing the lens mounted on the camera body (or the exact mount type written clearly).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only basic compatibility is confirmed (no extra accessories).

proof_requests: Clear, unblurred close-up of the full side label/model line (focal length + aperture).
Straight-on photos of both front and rear glass elements (no glare/blur).
Video test of autofocus working (near-to-far focus) on a camera.
Photo of the rear mount/contacts and confirmation of lens mount type.
response.reason: The lens is identifiable as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR, but the exact model (which determines the correct Oyo resale price) is obscured in the photos. Without the full model text and an optical/AF test, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
